method.contextDescription: A medical Prior Authorization Request form. The 'Member Information' section near the top has Last Name, First Name, Insurance ID #, DOB, and Date of Service fields.

queries.description: Read the 'First Name:' and 'Last Name:' fields in the Member Information section. Return them concatenated in that order as '<First Name value> <Last Name value>', separated by a single space, using the values exactly as entered even if they appear semantically swapped (e.g. do not try to correct which looks like a first vs last name).
the value written in the 'Insurance ID #:' field
the value written in the 'DOB:' field, exactly as written, do not reformat it
the date written in the 'Date of Service:' field

method.contextDescription: This form has three near-identical provider/facility blocks in this order: 'Requesting Provider:', then 'Servicing Provider:', then 'Servicing Facility:'. Each has its own Name, TIN#, and NPI#. Use only the values that immediately follow the specific label named in each question below — do not reuse a value from a different block.

queries.description: the name written next to 'Requesting Provider:' (the first of the three provider/facility blocks)
the TIN# value in the 'Requesting Provider:' block (the first of the three provider/facility blocks) — not the TIN# in the Servicing Provider or Servicing Facility blocks
the NPI# value in the 'Requesting Provider:' block (the first of the three provider/facility blocks) — not the NPI# in the Servicing Provider or Servicing Facility blocks
the name written next to 'Servicing Provider:' (the second of the three provider/facility blocks)
the TIN# value in the 'Servicing Provider:' block (the second of the three provider/facility blocks) — not the TIN# in the Requesting Provider or Servicing Facility blocks
the NPI# value in the 'Servicing Provider:' block (the second of the three provider/facility blocks) — not the NPI# in the Requesting Provider or Servicing Facility blocks
the name written next to 'Servicing Facility:' (the third of the three provider/facility blocks)
the TIN# value in the 'Servicing Facility:' block (the third of the three provider/facility blocks) — not the TIN# in the Requesting Provider or Servicing Provider blocks
the NPI# value in the 'Servicing Facility:' block (the third of the three provider/facility blocks) — not the NPI# in the Requesting Provider or Servicing Provider blocks

method.contextDescription: The 'Requested Item/Service:' section, followed by 'ICD-10 Code(s):' and 'CPT Code(s):' boxes.

queries.description: the text written next to 'Requested Item/Service:' describing the requested item or service
the ICD-10 code(s) written in the 'ICD-10 Code(s):' box; return null if blank
the CPT code(s) written in the 'CPT Code(s):' box; return null if blank
What service type(s) checkbox is marked? return the label(s). Can be multiple
What admission type(s) checkbox is marked? return the label(s).

method.contextDescription: The form has two separate 'Explanation Required:' fields: one in the 'Expedite-' section (the one about a determination being in serious jeopardy if not made in the standard timeframe), and one later in the 'In-Network Benefits' section. Only the first one (Expedite) is relevant here.

queries.description: Is there any text written after 'Explanation Required:' in the Expedite section (not the later In-Network Benefits section)? Answer true if any text is present there, false if it is blank.

method.contextDescription: The '**REQUIRED** Contact Information:' row near the bottom of the form, with Name, Phone #, and Fax# fields.

queries.description: the value written next to 'Name:' in the Contact Information row
the value written next to 'Phone #:' in the Contact Information row
